# MingXu / 命序

> Deterministic Chinese-metaphysics computation workspace for humans and AI agents. AstroCopy is the internal calculation-engine identity.

## Core tools

- BaZi / 八字四柱: https://mingxu.jackmeds.top/bazi/
- Zi Wei Dou Shu / 紫微斗数: https://mingxu.jackmeds.top/ziwei/
- Da Liu Ren / 大六壬: https://mingxu.jackmeds.top/liuren/
- True Solar Time / 真太阳时: https://mingxu.jackmeds.top/true-solar-time/
